product.description: A transparent pharmacy benefit management service that helps employers manage prescription drug benefits, medication access, and pharmacy spending through a 100% pass-through pricing model.

product.name: Care Navigation
product.description: A clinically supported healthcare navigation service that helps members understand benefits, resolve billing issues, find appropriate care and programs, and make healthcare decisions through digital tools and dedicated care teams.
